title: Submodel cross-boundary handle validation is hand-rolled twice, duplicating _resolve_submodel_endpoint
description: graph_to_code_multi validates submodel boundary handles in three places that share identical logic: (a) the inline input loop at 1013-1043 (checks handle.startswith('in__'), slices child_id, checks membership in sm_child_ids, raises the same two ParseError messages), (b) the inline output-validation loop at 1044-1068 (same for 'out__'), and (c) the _resolve_submodel_endpoint closure at 1117-1150 which performs exactly this validation for both prefixes and raises the same two ParseError messages. The closure was clearly introduced to centralize this, but the two earlier loops were never folded into it. Moreover the 1044-1068 loop is pure validation with no output: every edge whose source == submodel placeholder is later re-validated by _resolve_submodel_endpoint(prefix='out__') in the root_node_sources loop (1163) and root_connect_pairs loop (1202), so loop (b) is fully redundant. The input loop (a) only additionally accumulates src_name into sm_node_sources; its validation half duplicates the helper.
evidence: Lines 1017-1037 (in__ validation + child_id membership + ParseError 'missing or malformed targetHandle' / 'references a child node that does not exist') are byte-for-byte the same checks and messages as _resolve_submodel_endpoint lines 1128-1149. Lines 1048-1068 (out__ variant) duplicate the same helper for prefix='out__'. For any edge with source=='submodel__sm', _resolve_submodel_endpoint(edge, src, sh, prefix='out__', endpoint='source') at line 1163/1202 re-runs identical startswith/child_id/membership validation, so the 1044-1068 loop adds no checks not already enforced downstream. The only behavioural difference is the submodel= kwarg value (sm_name vs node_id.removeprefix('submodel__')), which are equal.
behavior_preservation: Refactoring loop (a) to call _resolve_submodel_endpoint for the in__ resolution (keeping only the src_name accumulation) and deleting the redundant loop (b) preserves behavior: the same handles are validated with the same ParseError types/messages, just once. The redundant out__ loop's only effect is raising on malformed out__ handles, which _resolve_submodel_endpoint already does at the same point in the same call (before any file is emitted), so no error is lost.
